observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show a white PlayStation 5 Slim console with the PS logo on the top left.
A DualSense controller is placed in front of the console, with a black and white design.
A stack of five blue game cases is visible to the right of the console, with the top case showing 'FCPS' (FIFA 25) on the cover.

No power cord, HDMI cable, or other accessories are visible in the photos.
